# The test files whose scratch-repository commits do not yet go through internal/testgit,
# one `file sites reason` per line: the sites are the commit calls and `git commit` command
# lines TestNoTestCommitsWithoutItsOwnGitIdentity reads in the file (internal/ci/
# git_identity_class_test.go, docs/SPEC-CI.md `git-identity`). A commit with no identity of
# its own takes the runner's global git config, and the hosted ubuntu-latest runner has none:
# `Author identity unknown` (dev run 37344601638, shard 6).
#
# Counted and shrink-only: a new site in a listed file is red, a fixed one asks for its count
# to be lowered, and NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 lowers counts and drops rows at zero, never adding one.
# The remedy for every row: run the command with cmd.Env = testgit.Env(t, os.Environ()).
#
# Every row was found when the rule landed, outside the paths of the card that landed it
# (pr-fix-wall-cover-git-identity): internal/swarm, the one package whose bare commit
# failed on the hosted runner, was moved onto testgit instead of listed.
# ceiling: 54
